signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Bring evidence to the roadmap. Surface the highest-value problems in agentic commerce and make the case for what we build next, based on what developers and users need.
Own the backlog. Keep it prioritized and current, and make sure every piece of work has an owner, a definition of done and a reason it matters.
Prototype ideas before they're specced, so the team reacts to something real.Write clear problem statements, requirements and acceptance criteria with engineering and design…
Define what good looks like when the user is an agent. Set the quality bar for how agents use our API and tools, and measure it over time.
Run the planning rhythm: sprint and quarterly planning, status updates and release notes, so everyone knows what’s shipping and when, and we keep time-to-value short.
